title: Figure 23: Engineering the complex reflectivity coefficient of a MetaMirror
description: Left: schematic of a "Leaky Mirror" layer over an "Absorbing Material" layer with reflection coefficients r2 and r0 indicated by arrows. Right: plot of |r2| and phase(r2) for V and H polarizations versus k (680-760 cm^-1), with an inset unit-cell rendering and an inset micrograph of the fabricated MetaMirror. Caption: "Figure 23. Engineering the Complex Reflectivity Coefficient r2 Defined on the Left Panel Using the Concept of a MetaMirror."
